evidence: Labeled 'Mining', touches block template management in src/node/block_template_manager.cpp and the node's mining interface in src/node/miner.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a data race where concurrent worker calls can race when `submitSolution()` modifies an active template while another call reads it (issue #36515). It also improves mining interface efficiency by providing `getTotalFees()` to avoid fetching and summing fee vectors across process boundaries.
